response.overview: Collection of 3 Short Films  1. Getting Some Disciplinary Action Intern Emma (Aria Sloane) wants to impress her gorgeous boss, Julie (Jayden Cole). While sorting Julie’s mail, she opens a mysterious package containing a dildo. Julie catches her but, rather than getting angry, decides to reward her mistake with a steamy office encounter.  2. Detention Bound Riley (Zoey Uso) deliberately gets detention to spend time alone with her teacher, Ms. Charlotte (Kali Roses). Their ongoing secret affair heats up as Charlotte incorporates Riley’s school necktie into some light bondage.  3. Shower Spy Games When neighbor Trish (Jewel Diamant) asks Sharon (Isa Bella) to use her shower, Sharon agrees. Unable to resist, Sharon secretly watches Trish showering. Caught spying, Sharon discovers Trish is intrigued and invited to join her for a steamy encounter.
response.title: Disciplinary Action
